hero.tagline: Delight your fragrance, aroma, and flavor
hero.description: We are specialty coffee growers and producers in Pueblo Bello, Colombia. Guided by the Arhuaco meaning of Kinki —real, true, and original— we bring the soul of the Sierra straight to your cup with the dedication of the Pérez Arroyo family.

kinki.title: The Meaning of
kinki.subtitle: In the ancestral language of the Arhuaco people of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, the word Kinki means:
kinki.p1: For the Pérez Arroyo family, Kafé Kinki is far more than a name: it is a commitment to origin, identity, and deep reverence for the sacred mountains of the Sierra Nevada. Their Indigenous roots guide every step on the farm, knowing coffee is a living bridge between the mountain mists, the fertile earth, and caring hands.
kinki.p2: Naming our coffee Kinki honors the genuine: coffee free from artificial shortcuts or industrial processing, shade-grown beneath native forest canopies and hand-harvested with patience and honesty.

story.title: From our land
story.producerStamp: The family of growers behind every bean
story.p1: Behind every bag of Kafé Kinki is the Pérez Arroyo family, coffee growers and producers from Pueblo Bello, Cesar. Their bond with coffee was forged not in a corporate boardroom, but along the mountain trails of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta.
story.p2: Unlike mass industrial coffee, Kafé Kinki is the result of family, independent, and small-batch craftsmanship. Every coffee tree is planted, naturally nourished, and cared for by hand, safeguarding the living biodiversity of the mountain ecosystem.
story.quote: Growing specialty coffee is more than an occupation—it is our way of honoring the land and sharing the genuine aroma of the Sierra with the world.

origin.title: From the Sierra Nevada to your cup,
origin.subtitle: Kafé Kinki's authenticity stems from the sacred geography of Pueblo Bello and respect for every stage of the coffee's transformation.

stages.title: Pueblo Bello
stages.subtitle: Cesar, Colombia • Mountain Foothills
stages.description: The starting point in the foothills of the Sierra Nevada. A fertile agricultural haven surrounded by lush vegetation, pure water, and profound coffee-growing heritage.
highlights: Fertile mountain foothills in the Sierra Nevada
Rich volcanic soils and pristine water sources

stages.title: Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta
stages.subtitle: Sacred Mountain • Altitude & Clouds
stages.description: The highest coastal mountain on Earth creates fresh air currents, morning mists, and unique microclimates that foster slow, sweet, and balanced bean maturation.
highlights: Morning mists and constant mountain breeze
Slow cherry maturation concentrating natural sugars

stages.title: Shade-Grown Farming
stages.subtitle: Family Coffee Farm • Daily Stewardship
stages.description: In Pueblo Bello, coffee trees thrive sheltered beneath native forest canopies. The Pérez Arroyo family tends and walks their plots daily, caring for leaf health, blossoming flowers, and living soils.
highlights: Safeguarding local biodiversity and mountain soil
Gentle, respectful daily care of every tree

stages.title: Selective Hand Harvesting
stages.subtitle: Peak Ripeness • Rigorous Selection
stages.description: Harvesting is patient manual labor. No harsh mechanical harvesters are used: trained eyes and gentle hands select exclusively the deep-crimson ripe cherries.
highlights: Full protection of tree health and future crops

stages.title: Sun Drying on Raised Beds
stages.subtitle: Drying Patios & Beds • Andean Sunlight
stages.description: The coffee is depulped and spread over ventilated raised drying beds. Andean sunshine and mountain breezes gently dry the beans to ideal moisture levels.
highlights: Slow drying on ventilated African raised beds
Preservation of delicate aroma and essential oils

stages.title: Your Cup of Coffee
stages.subtitle: At Your Table • Fresh Medium Roast
stages.description: A genuine Kinki (real, true, and original) experience, roasted in small batches to highlight fragrance, aroma, and flavor. Straight from the mountain to your table.
highlights: Medium roast highlighting fragrance, aroma, and body
Available in whole bean and precision ground
100% artisanal coffee direct from the producer family
